concerns.text: FR-008 (VIF exclusion logic) is not covered. T009 implements VIF calculation but explicitly excludes exclusion logic ('VIF > 5 calculation ONLY, no exclusion logic'). T025b is marked as a rejected task with a missing artifact. No task exists to implement the logic that excludes predictors with VIF > 5 from the regression input, leaving FR-008 and SC-004 unimplemented.

FR-009 (Sensitivity Analysis) is not covered. T024 (sensitivity utility) is marked as a rejected task with a missing artifact. T023b (execution) references a missing utility and has a typo in the sweep values description ('{, 0.05, 0.1}' missing 0.01). No valid task implements the sensitivity sweep logic required by FR-009.

FR-010 (Thermal Source Provenance) and SC-001 (>=50 entries) are not fully covered. T014b (fetch thermal) and T015 (merge) are marked as rejected/missing. T038 (Conflict Documentation) is also missing. Without T014b and T015, the pipeline cannot fetch thermal data from the required sources or enforce the >=50 entry count, leaving FR-010 and SC-001 unimplemented.

FR-015 (R² Target Justification) is not covered. T031 depends on the 'Reference-Validator Agent' verifying a citation, but T010 and T039 (validation tasks) are marked as rejected/missing. No task exists to generate the justification text or verify the Smith et al. (2021) citation, leaving FR-015 unimplemented.

Constitution VII Conflict Resolution is not covered. T038 (Document Constitution VII vs FR-010 conflict) is marked as rejected/missing. The plan acknowledges a conflict between Constitution VII (allows MP thermal endpoint) and FR-010 (excludes MP thermal), but no task exists to document the override or resolve the conflict as required by the Constitution.

Stale/Invalid Task Reference: T024 is referenced in T023 and T023b as 'src/utils/sensitivity.py', but T024 is marked as a rejected task with a missing artifact. This creates a broken dependency chain for the sensitivity analysis.
Stale/Invalid Task Reference: T014b is referenced in T015 and T016 as a dependency, but T014b is marked as a rejected task. This breaks the data ingestion pipeline for thermal conductivity.

Stale/Invalid Task Reference: T010 and T039 are referenced as prerequisites for T031 (citation verification), but both are marked as rejected/missing. This prevents the generation of the R² justification required by FR-015.
